ImageAcquisitionProtocol: data was acquired using a 1310nm swept-source OCT system with polarization sensitivity; acquisition was performed in a snake-by-columns pattern ordered up-right; acquisition was performed with a 1.6mm step size in X direction and 2.8mm step size in Y direction; acquired at mechanical tilt of 15 degrees
OtherAcquisitionParameters: Raw spectral-domain PS-OCT interferograms (int16; the header declares uint16). Array order is [spectral sample (1152, k-space), A-line (2 x 200: channel 1 co-polarization, then channel 2 cross-polarization; fast axis, X), B-scan (350; slow axis, Y)]
